params.948: Speak with TzHaar-Mej-Jeh at the TzHaar Birthing Pool.
params.949: Rune pickaxe or better. Armour, weapons and food are strongly advised.
params.950: Must be able to beat multiple lvl 300+ foes.
params.951: 2 Quest Points, 100,000 XP Lamp (for either Attack, Strength, Defence, Magic or Ranged), 50,000 Magic XP, 30,000 Agility XP, A Tokkul-Zo (boosts 10% damage when fighting against lava or obsidian creatures), access to the Fight Kiln and 2 spins on the Squeal of Fortune.
